adjudication_summary: Worker-6 re-review repaired the framework-test failure by source-checking BRIP against XML/PDF/supplement/database evidence, adding source-located activity/toxicity rows, preserving DRAMP field conflicts, and closing the targeted rework ticket as accepted_with_cautions rather than clean acceptance.

caution_findings.evidence_context: DRAMP labels the entity BPIP, while primary paper title, sequence section, results, and methods consistently use BRIP.
DRAMP cytotoxicity field says no cytotoxicity information, but the primary paper reports rat erythrocyte hemolysis classes for BRIP.
Exact per-concentration percent hemolysis bar heights are not text-recoverable from local XML/PDF text; the source-supported qualitative classes are retained and no exact values were invented.
Primary evidence supports in vitro Mpro enzyme inhibition plus computational binding/stability modeling, not whole-virus or cellular antiviral mechanism.

materials_exhausted.oa_package: oa_package checked; packet and asset manifest show no OA archive/package members for this paper
materials_exhausted.notes: Local XML/PDF, parsed supplementary PDF text, HTML landing-page .bin assets, and linked DRAMP database rows were opened. Remaining exact figure bar heights were not text-recoverable and are nonblocking because qualitative source classes and IC50 are available.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DRAMP core sequence and Mpro IC50 can be matched to the primary source, but BPIP-vs-BRIP name text, cytotoxicity-field omission, and synthetic-source wording remain explicit source_conflict cautions.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Source-supported rows were recovered from Figure 2/result prose and methods: Mpro IC50, complete inhibition range, non-hemolytic 500 nM class, and slight hemolysis at 50 uM. No unsupported numeric bar heights were fabricated.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism is bounded to direct target-enzyme inhibition plus computational Mpro-BRIP binding/stability modeling; no cellular antiviral or clinical mechanism is promoted.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_final_decision: All blocking rework targets from rwk-complete-test-0001 are resolved locally; remaining issues are nonblocking cautions, so the paper is accepted_with_cautions and publication_grade true.
